options.title: No direct contact
options.description: Parents don't call or message each other directly. Child information goes through the app's templates only.

options.title: Structured template messages
options.description: Schedule, health, school and expense updates use set templates, each with a short optional note.

options.title: Flexible swaps by direct message
options.description: Parents arrange schedule swaps by messaging each other directly.

options.title: Joint decision meetings
options.description: Parents meet in person or by video to make decisions together.

options.title: Supervised or third-party exchanges
options.description: A trusted third person or a supervised exchange service handles hand-offs.

options.title: Safe-exchange site
options.description: Hand-offs happen at a set safe-exchange location, such as a monitored public site.

options.title: Staggered arrival times
options.description: One parent arrives and leaves before the other arrives, so parents don't meet.

options.title: Exchanges through school or childcare
options.description: One parent drops off at school or childcare and the other picks up.

options.title: Flexible hand-offs at either home
options.description: Parents agree each time where and when the hand-off happens.

options.title: Separate school and activity contact
options.description: Each parent has their own contact with the school, doctors and activities and gets their own copies of notices.

options.title: Shared events with both parents
options.description: Both parents attend birthdays, school events and activities together.

options.title: Each home runs its own routine
options.description: Each parent makes everyday decisions during their own time, without checking with the other.

options.title: Fixed written schedule
options.description: A set schedule. Changes go through a template or a professional, not by direct request.

options.title: Joint everyday decisions
options.description: Parents talk through everyday decisions together before acting.

options.title: Flexible schedule by agreement
options.description: Parents adjust the schedule together as needs change.
